title: Ten arms / simpler devotional illustration
positive: A beautiful sacred Indian painting of ten-armed Durga seated frontally beside her golden lion. A balanced panoramic composition, dark background, full crown visible. Durga wears a crimson sari and elaborate gold jewelry with diamond highlights. Her gentle beautiful face has matching brown eyes, a calm gaze and a small vertical forehead eye. Exactly ten arms and ten hands in total, arranged as FIVE hands on each side of her body. All ten hands hold an object; there is no additional blessing hand. Arms emerge together from the two shoulder regions with smooth continuous anatomy. On the viewer left, the five hands hold a golden discus, a straight sword, a three-pronged trident, a single feathered arrow and a round shield. On the viewer right, five hands hold a white spiral conch shell, a curved strung bow, a small brass handbell, a single axe and a coil of rope. Every object has a distinct silhouette, every hand has a clear grip. The lion has a realistic body, soft full mane, two matching amber eyes and relaxed paws. Warm gold halo, rich red and gold, finely painted face, luxurious but reverent beauty, generous dark space at the outer edges.
negative: extra blessing hand, empty hand, three axes, duplicated weapon, floating weapon, deformed fingers, branching arms, detached hands, crossed eyes, asymmetric pupils, blank eyes, horn in place of conch, cartoon lion, multiple lions, chopped crown, text, watermark, noisy glitter, blurry face
